name: manual_95140c
claim: When dual_path_dispatch.py fails locally on Mac with 'Context overflow' due to openclaw agent workspace limits, bypass it by compressing the payload and dropping it directly into the peer inbox using lan_peer_assign.py drop.

decisions.notes: The local openclaw agent can hit context limits when processing large payloads or orchestrator cards. Direct drops to the lan_peer/inbox using lan_peer_assign.py bypass the local model and rely on the remote peer's pulse-gate for ingestion.

rationale: The local openclaw agent can hit context limits when processing large payloads or orchestrator cards. Direct drops to the lan_peer/inbox using lan_peer_assign.py bypass the local model and rely on the remote peer's pulse-gate for ingestion.
